_comment: The P-15B design itself (docs/DSV4-P15B设计.md): 28 layers, compress_ratios [0,0]+[4,128]x12+[0,0]. The r0/r4/r128 files are the same model with a single layer, for the profiler, which always builds num_hidden_layers=1.
_intermediate_size_comment: Set to the expert width on purpose: the profiler's TP emulation divides SHARD_FIELDS = [intermediate_size, num_attention_heads, num_key_value_heads, vocab_size], and moe_intermediate_size is NOT in that list. Leaving this at anything else makes TP=2 profile an unsharded MoE.
